text: The customer is reporting that their smart plug (Order LM-51310) unexpectedly turns off around 2:00 AM every night. So far, the agent confirmed there are no active schedules set in the app and instructed the customer to run a firmware update. Next, the customer is completing the firmware update and will monitor the plug tonight to see if the issue persists, with a replacement planned if it does not resolve the problem.
